jobs.title: Manager FP&A, Distribution Partnerships
jobs.description:
Spotify is looking for a commercially minded FP&A Manager to serve as the dedicated finance partner for our Distribution Partnerships team. Distribution Partnerships play an important role in Spotify's growth strategy by working with strategic partners to expand user acquisition, deepen engagement, and improve retention through innovative distribution and marketing initiatives.
In this role, you'll build the financial foundations that help shape partnership decisions. You'll develop robust business cases, subscriber models, and end-to-end P&L analyses that connect user growth with business outcomes. You'll partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate opportunities, challenge assumptions, and provide insights that help leaders make confident, data-informed decisions.
 

What You'll Do
- Lead business case development for Distribution Partnerships by building investment models that combine subscriber forecasts, partnership economics, and full P&L impact.

- Develop financial frameworks that evaluate new and existing partnerships, including lifetime value, payback periods, return on investment, and other key performance metrics.

- Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and risks that inform partnership strategy and investment decisions.

- Partner closely with Distribution Partnerships, Accounting, Business Affairs, Legal, Strategy, and other cross-functional teams to translate financial insights into clear recommendations for business and senior leaders.

- Build, maintain, and continuously improve reporting for the partnership portfolio, including KPIs, performance tracking, forecasting, and variance analysis.

- Support annual planning, quarterly forecasting, and ongoing financial planning activities by partnering with business leaders to establish data-driven targets.

- Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting, and tooling to help Spotify evaluate and manage partnerships more effectively.
Who You Are
- You have 5+ years of experience in FP&A, Strategy & Analytics, Investment Banking, Corporate Finance, or a similar analytical role. Experience in a consumer subscription business is a plus.

- You have experience building sophisticated financial models and performing scenario analysis in environments with evolving information and changing priorities.

- You know how to translate commercial agreements into meaningful financial outcomes and have experience partnering with Legal, Business Affairs, commercial, or deal teams.

- You are comfortable working with large datasets. Experience with SQL is preferred, and you are interested in applying AI tools to improve financial analysis and decision-making.

- You balance strong attention to detail with sound judgment, knowing when additional analysis will meaningfully improve a decision and when it is time to move forward.

- You manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining a high standard of quality in a fast-moving environment.

- You are naturally curious and enjoy exploring problems beyond the initial question to uncover insights that create business value.

- You communicate complex financial concepts clearly and tailor your recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Where You'll be
- For this role, the preferred locations are Stockholm or London.

- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best!  We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

jobs.title: Program Manager - Podcast Sales Strategy & Solutions
jobs.description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 


Podcast Sales Strategy & Solutions (PS3) shapes how Spotify brings podcast advertising to market. We partner across sales, content, talent, and operations to set the strategy behind our podcast ad business, from developing and pricing new ad formats to positioning our show portfolio, launching new shows, and giving sales teams the insight and tools they need to grow revenue

We’re looking for a Program Manager to drive key podcast ad operations across The Ringer portfolio. You’ll connect Spotify’s sales organization with content, talent, and operations teams, keeping high-volume approvals and booking workflows moving while helping our sales teams understand what can run, where, and when. You’ll be close to the full lifecycle of podcast advertising and help make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

What You'll Do
- Manage Integrated Solutions approvals and vetting across The Ringer podcast portfolio, triaging incoming sponsorship requests, coordinating with the right partners, and tracking requests through resolution.

- Maintain a clear view of approvals across formats and shows, including what is approved, declined, pending, or escalated.

- Be a day-to-day partner to sales teams on approval timelines, show availability, booking logistics, and podcast advertising formats, and help resolve campaign-specific blockers.

- Serve as a key connection between Spotify’s sales organization and The Ringer Studios Business Operations team, translating new formats, processes, and advertising products into clear and consistent execution.

- Manage The Ringer Podcast Booking Calendar, including inbound holds and bookings, new shows, editorial calendar updates, and post-sale booking changes.

- Coordinate the PS3 workstream for new Ringer show launches, partnering across pricing, talent preferences, Creative Operations, sales enablement, and go-to-market readiness.

- Support new advertising format rollouts and maintain accurate sales resources, including show sheets, FAQs, format guidance, booking tools, and other enablement materials.

- Use campaign, booking, inventory, and revenue information to identify discrepancies, surface recurring questions, and improve the consistency and efficiency of day-to-day processes.
Who You Are
- You have 3+ years of experience in media operations, advertising operations, sales support, program management, or another coordination-heavy environment.

- You’re comfortable partnering closely with sales teams and can translate what a seller needs into clear operational next steps.

- You understand the relationship between content and advertising and can navigate situations where talent preferences, brand suitability, format requirements, and commercial needs intersect.

- You’re highly organized and have a reliable approach to managing multiple open requests, dependencies, and deadlines at once.

- You communicate clearly and concisely across different audiences, from sales partners and talent representatives to content and operations teams.

- You’re comfortable working with data and revenue information, maintaining trackers, running reports, and identifying discrepancies.

- You’re comfortable with tools such as spreadsheets, Asana, Coda, Google Workspace, Slack, Salesforce, and AI-enabled tools, and can learn new systems quickly.

- You bring a collaborative, adaptable approach and are comfortable pitching in across a small team with a broad remit. Experience with podcast advertising, digital audio, media sales operations, talent approvals, or The Ringer ecosystem can help you get up to speed quickly.
Where You'll Be
- This role is based in Los Angeles or New York

- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
The United States base range for this position is $75,737 - $108,196 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. jobs.title: Artist Label Partnerships Manager, Taiwan
jobs.description:
We are looking for a strategic-minded, execution-oriented Artists & Label Partnerships Manager for Taiwan, to join Spotify’s Music team based in Taipei. In this role, you will be part of the Music team in Southeast Asia, reporting to the regional Head of Artists & Label Partnerships.
 
You will sit at the heart of the music ecosystem, moving between high-level release strategies and the day-to-day tactical execution that drives artist and business growth. This role is perfect for a music industry professional who thrives on building relationships and navigating the intersection of technology and creativity.
 
Our ideal candidate has fun at work and a desire to make a positive impact on the music industry as a whole. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape. This role is based in Taipei and will require international travel occasionally.

What You'll Do
- Focusing on the Taiwan music landscape, You will be the primary point of contact for local and global music partners based in Taiwan, ensuring that Spotify remains the most valued partner for artists and our industry partners, utilising on-platform promotion and off-platform marketing to ensure Spotify is the premiere platform for artist development

- Develop and execute a holistic music strategy for Taiwan that aligns with regional business goals

- You will contribute your expertise to various music-related projects within the company, executing on creative and cross-functional collaborations in the region and beyond, building impactful and innovative artist partnerships to enable artists and artist-fan engagement

- You will proactively identify music trends, emerging talent and opportunities in the local and global music landscape, providing deep cultural and musical insights with the local SEA team to execute pivotal initiatives, your global counterparts on multi-market campaigns and other key internal partners & teams including editorial, artist marketing, consumer marketing, licensing and others

- Support and educate our key partners across artists and labels communities in Taiwan on Spotify tools, resources and insights to encourage them and improve their daily business

- Lead artists & label partnerships representation in high-impact cross-functional projects and strategic bets at both a regional and global level

- Ensure Spotify has the best possible content offering in Taiwan and use this to further Spotify’s appeal to existing and new users

- Work with regional Editorial teams and regional Genre Groups on high priority releases, as well as other cross-functional teams to progress towards various content objectives

- Connect other Spotify teams with the music industry to help drive and execute opportunities driven by Spotify and our partners. You will act as liaison between Spotify and artist / label partners.
Who You Are
- You have at least 7+ years of working experience with label and artist relations in an established digital music service, record label, media or tech company. Regional and global experience would be an added advantage

- You have a deep understanding and established network within the local music industry in Taiwan and have built relevant contacts with labels and artists to effectively collaborate with the community

- You will demonstrate a team player spirit, a passion for performance-oriented analytics, and a solid understanding of Spotify’s role in the music industry both locally and globally

- You are skilled at leveraging data and audience insights to support strategic decisions and build clear narratives

- You are culturally aware, with the ability to critically evaluate music trends, emerging movements and audience behaviour beyond just data

- You are a confident storyteller and public speaker. You are able to prepare and deliver executive level presentations, effectively advocate for the market and secure stakeholder buy-in with ease

- You are well organised and detail-oriented with the ability to plan, deliver on tight deadlines and pay outstanding attention to detail

- You are at ease and have proven experience navigating fast-changing priorities in a dynamic environment, comfortable navigating complex global-to-local organizational structures and aligning cross-functional teams around Music priorities

- You have strong project management skills with a consistent record in marketing and operations

- You have excellent negotiation and people skills and consistently demonstrates a positive attitude

- You have experience working within Taiwan and ideally across multiple markets within regional and global teams

- Fluent in English and Mandarin. Fluency in regional languages would be an added advantage
Where You'll Be
- This role is based in Taipei

jobs.title: Business Development Senior Manager, APAC
jobs.description:
At Spotify, we’re passionate about delivering the right audio experience for every moment. We’ve connected hundreds of millions of people to the content they love and built the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service. We operate in more than 180 markets and continue to scale rapidly across APAC.
 
We’re building a world-class business development team and are looking for a multi-talented self-starter with ambition and drive who will help grow Spotify’s Premium distribution partnerships in the APAC region. You will own, negotiate, and scale strategic agreements with partners who can accelerate subscriber and engagement growth. This role will be based in either Singapore or Seoul and you will report to the APAC Director of Business Development. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

What You'll Do
- Identify, structure, negotiate, amend, close, and manage strategic distribution partnerships across APAC that advance Spotify’s growth and long‑term vision.

- Develop and refine partner strategies for priority markets in collaboration with the regional lead, carrying out detailed partner analysis and setting priorities and forecasts.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for partners, building credibility across all levels—from C‑suite to Marketing to Commercial teams —and owning the full relationship lifecycle.

- Analyze existing partnerships to unlock additional value, improve performance, and uncover opportunities for expansion.

- Manage internal approvals including interacting with senior internal executives from relevant functions (e.g., Legal, Finance, Accounting, Product).

- Drive internal cross‑functional workstreams toward deal objectives, ensuring clarity, alignment, and timely execution.

- Manage a pipeline of prospective partnerships and assess commercial impact through disciplined analysis and business case development.

- Travel as needed across APAC to strengthen partner relationships and support deal execution.
Who You Are
- You have a minimum of 5+ years of significant business development or strategic partnerships experience within APAC—ideally across telcos, OEMs, payments, entertainment, or digital platforms.

- Fluency in English and Korean is required for the role; other additional APAC languages a plus.

- You have a proven track record of structuring and closing complex deals with large enterprises and scaling partnerships with measurable commercial impact.

- You understand the nuances of APAC markets and bring relevant local insights; deep experience in Korea, Thailand or Indonesia is especially valuable.

- You think strategically about complex business issues, yet you’re equally strong in operational execution and relationship ownership.

- You excel in multicultural, fast‑moving environments and collaborate effectively across distributed teams.

- You have strong experience negotiating contracts, understanding legal frameworks, and partnering effectively with attorneys.

- You are comfortable working with product, engineering, and design teams and translate technical concepts to non‑technical team members with ease.

- You are analytical, data‑driven, and experienced in financial modelling and constructing clear business cases.

- You communicate with clarity and influence, simplifying complexity for senior audiences internally and externally.

- You are diligent with strong commercial instincts and the ability to see long‑term value in every opportunity.

- You demonstrate initiative, resilience, and the ability to independently drive deals from ideation to launch.

- BA/BS degree with outstanding academic performance; MBA a plus.

- Experience in using basic AI tools.
Where You'll Be
- This role is based in either Singapore or Seoul, South Korea.

jobs.title: Growth Manager
jobs.description:
You’ll join the Premium Growth India team within the Markets & Subscriptions organisation, responsible for converting free users into Premium subscribers and keeping them there. Sitting at the intersection of strategy, marketing, product, and data, the team works to sustainably grow Spotify’s Premium subscriber base in India.

In this role, you’ll drive demand capture and retention for Premium India by localising global strategies, developing India-specific initiatives, and executing across conversion funnels, offers, lifecycle programs, and win-back initiatives. You’ll collaborate with global and regional Growth teams as well as local Marketing and Music teams, while owning execution and experimentation in India.
What You’ll Do
-
Localise and execute the Premium demand capture strategy for India, adapting global frameworks and developing India-specific offer strategies and organic conversion opportunities in collaboration with global and regional Growth teams.

-
Drive programs that reduce voluntary and involuntary churn, anticipating retention risks and developing initiatives to retain and win back users.

-
Own CRM execution using in-house tools to build, manage, and optimise communication journeys across email, push, and in-app channels to improve conversion and retention.

-
Develop and test new conversion and retention approaches, bringing fresh thinking to how we turn free users into Premium subscribers and keep them engaged.

-
Analyse conversion and retention data to identify funnel drop-offs and cohort-specific opportunities, translating insights into clear recommendations and business cases.

-
Design and run A/B tests and experiments across the funnel and CRM channels to improve conversion and subscriber lifetime value.

-
Collaborate with Marketing to connect conversion programs with top-of-funnel activity and key brand moments, and partner with Finance to model offer economics, forecast subscriber growth, and evaluate investment returns.

-
Capture and share learnings that strengthen the Premium Growth playbook, contribute to global best practices, and support cross-regional Growth initiatives when business priorities require it.

-
Integrate AI-driven tools and workflows thoughtfully to improve decision-making and execution efficiency.
Who You Are
-
You have 3+ years of experience in growth, CRM, lifecycle marketing, conversion optimisation, or a related area within a digital consumer business such as streaming, e-commerce, fintech, gaming, or media.

-
You have hands-on CRM and lifecycle marketing experience, including building and optimising communication journeys and managing campaign calendars across channels such as email, push, and in-app messaging.

-
You are comfortable working with large datasets and understand how to ask the right analytical questions, interpret data, and turn insights into decisions.

-
You combine creative and analytical thinking, approaching problems from different angles while using rigorous funnel analysis to reach actionable conclusions.

-
You take initiative and ownership, proactively identifying opportunities and moving solutions forward.

-
You work effectively across functions and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, collaborating with partners across Product, Data, Marketing, Finance, and other teams to influence shared outcomes.
Where You’ll Be
-
This role is based in Mumbai

-
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

jobs.title: Growth Manager MENAT+
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Growth Manager to join Spotify's SAMEA Growth team within Markets and Subscriptions. You'll help more listeners discover, choose, and stay with Spotify Premium across the Middle East, North Africa, Turkey, Pakistan, and CIS markets (MENAT+).
Working closely with local market teams and colleagues across Marketing, Product, Data, and Commercial, you'll turn growth opportunities into campaigns, experiments, and measurable results. Our team combines local market knowledge, creativity, and data to build meaningful listener experiences and grow Premium subscriptions.
This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys bringing ideas to life, learning through experimentation, and making things happen. You'll take ownership of growth initiatives across multiple markets, from planning and execution to performance analysis and optimisation, helping shape how Spotify Premium grows across a diverse and dynamic region.

What You’ll Do
- Own the execution of Premium growth initiatives across selected MENAT+ markets, contributing to subscriber and revenue growth.

- Plan, build, and deliver customer relationship management (CRM) and lifecycle campaigns across email, push notifications, and in-app messaging, from initial brief through launch and optimisation.

- Identify opportunities to improve acquisition, conversion, and retention by analysing listener behaviour, campaign performance, and subscription trends.

- Partner with Marketing, Music, and local market teams to bring Premium to life through paid media, artist collaborations, cultural moments, and locally relevant campaigns.

- Collaborate with paid media teams and agencies to deliver effective digital campaigns across social and other channels, managing timelines, briefs, and budgets.

- Design, execute, and evaluate A/B tests across owned and paid channels, translating results into practical recommendations and future growth opportunities.

- Work with Product, Data Science, and Payments teams to identify growth opportunities, test new capabilities, and build evidence that informs product priorities.

- Track performance, communicate insights, and contribute to business cases and shared growth playbooks, using AI-powered tools where relevant to improve analysis, planning, and execution.
Who You Are
- You bring 4+ years of experience in growth marketing, digital marketing, or a related field within a consumer-focused digital business.

- You have hands-on experience building and delivering CRM, lifecycle, and digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels, with a strong understanding of the customer journey.

- You know how to design and evaluate A/B tests, interpret results, and turn insights into meaningful improvements.

- You understand how acquisition, conversion, and retention contribute to subscription growth, and you're familiar with metrics such as customer lifetime value, subscriber acquisition cost, and gross margin.

- You are confident working with analytics platforms, CRM tools, and experimentation frameworks. Experience with SQL and subscription-based businesses would be valuable.

- You are organised and comfortable managing multiple priorities, taking ownership of delivery, identifying challenges early, and finding practical solutions.

- You enjoy collaborating with people across different functions and markets, communicate clearly, and bring curiosity, creativity, and a willingness to learn. You're also comfortable using AI tools to support your work.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager Taiwan
jobs.description:
Spotify is looking for a Marketing Manager to lead our marketing strategy and execution in Taiwan. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who can set strategy, lead integrated campaigns, create scroll-stopping social content, and make Spotify one of the most talked-about brands in one of Asia's most vibrant music markets.
Taiwan is the birthplace of Mandopop and a cultural tastemaker for the broader Chinese-speaking world. Growing the Spotify brand and business in this market demands genuine cultural fluency, a deep understanding of what resonates across social platforms, strong relationships within the music and creative industries, and the ability to turn insights into bold, locally relevant campaigns that grow our listener base and strengthen our connection with fans and artists.
Reporting to the SEA Head of Marketing, you'll work closely with cross-functional teams across Taiwan and the wider region to shape strategy, deliver impactful campaigns, and represent the Taiwan market at a regional and global level.
You'll partner with teams across Music, Growth, Communications, Business Development, Partnerships, and other functions to bring Spotify's brand to life in Taiwan and help unlock new opportunities for growth.

What You'll Do 
- Own Spotify Taiwan's consumer marketing strategy, driving free user acquisition, engagement, and Premium consideration

- Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, out-of-home, experiential, and earned media with ideas designed to spark conversation and deliver measurable business impact

- Lead go-to-market planning for key product launches, seasonal campaigns, and major cultural moments

- Localize global campaigns for Taiwanese audiences, ensuring every activation reflects genuine cultural relevance rather than simple translation

- Use audience insights, market intelligence, and campaign performance data to inform decisions and continuously optimize marketing effectiveness

- Measure, analyze, and communicate campaign performance to regional leadership through clear recommendations and actionable insights

- Lead Spotify's Taiwan brand strategy in alignment with regional and global positioning while ensuring the brand feels authentic and locally meaningful

- Partner closely with the Taiwan Music team to develop campaigns supporting priority local and global releases and create scalable marketing frameworks for label partners

- Manage the Taiwan marketing budget, prioritizing investments that deliver the greatest impact

- Build and maintain strong relationships with creative, media, production, and agency partners to consistently deliver high-quality work

- Act as the voice of the Taiwan market, influencing regional and global stakeholders on campaign strategy, creative development, and market priorities
Who You Are
- You have 6+ years of experience in consumer or brand marketing, with strong experience leading marketing initiatives in Taiwan

- You have deep knowledge of Taiwan's music, entertainment, and cultural landscape, including Mandopop, emerging artists, internet culture, and local media

- You have successfully led integrated marketing campaigns from strategy through execution that delivered measurable business results

- You have created or led campaigns and social content that generated outsized reach, engagement, or cultural conversation relative to budget

- You know how to use data and customer insights to develop business cases, evaluate campaign performance, and optimize future marketing investments

- You have experience managing agencies, external partners, and cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment

- You have exceptional storytelling instincts and understand how to create culturally relevant campaigns that resonate with Taiwanese audiences

- You communicate confidently with senior stakeholders and can influence decisions across regional and global teams

- You are highly organized, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment

- You have experience working within technology, media, entertainment, or other consumer-focused industries

- You are fluent in both Mandarin and English, written and spoken
Where You'll Be
- This role is based in Taipei

- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

jobs.title: Partner Manager - Lifestyle & Wellness
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Partner Manager to join Spotify’s Content Partnerships team and build meaningful relationships with creators across Lifestyle & Wellness. You’ll be a trusted partner to creators, helping them understand their performance, develop their audiences, adopt Spotify products, and find new opportunities to grow.
You’ll bring a strong understanding of video, podcasts, and the broader creator ecosystem. You’ll combine creator relationships, data, and sound judgment to help shape how Spotify supports creators across Lifestyle & Wellness, with a particular focus on Fitness.

What You'll Do
-
Manage relationships with a portfolio of Spotify creators across Lifestyle & Wellness, helping them grow their presence and audiences on Spotify.

-
Support the growth of Fitness on Spotify by identifying, recruiting, and onboarding high-value and high-potential creators and video content.

-
Develop a deep understanding of creators’ businesses and goals, connecting them with Spotify products, programs, and opportunities that can deliver meaningful value.

-
Use performance data and audience insights to advise creators on content strategy, audience development, and opportunities for growth.

-
Help shape Spotify’s creator strategy and partner approach for Fitness by bringing forward creator insights, opportunities, and ideas as the space evolves.

-
Develop and test new ways to support and engage creators, identifying successful approaches that can scale across the broader creator ecosystem.

-
Collaborate with teams across Spotify to support priority creators, increase adoption of relevant products and features, and advance partner and company initiatives.

-
Bring creator feedback, portfolio trends, and quantitative and qualitative insights back into Spotify to help inform content and product strategy.
Who You Are
-
You have 5+ years of partner-facing experience in creator or talent relations, account management, business development, or a related field within an audio, video, social, talent management, or creator-focused organization.

-
You have established relationships with podcasters and/or video creators and understand how to build trusted, long-term creator partnerships.

-
You understand the audio, video, social, and creator landscape, including emerging formats and trends across Lifestyle, Wellness, and Fitness.

-
You identify opportunities, develop ideas, and move work forward in areas where the path may not yet be fully defined.

You communicate clearly and build credibility with creators, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Manager
jobs.description:
You’ll join the Premium Growth India team within the Markets & Subscriptions organisation, focused on making Spotify Premium an increasingly desirable music experience in India. Sitting at the intersection of marketing, product, music, and strategy, the team works closely with Music, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to grow Premium through cultural relevance and artist-led initiatives.

In this role, you’ll own Premium desirability and the artist and partner Premium flywheel for India, shaping how we work with artists, cultural moments, fandom, and partnerships to drive Premium consideration and measurable conversion at scale.
What You’ll Do
-
Define and execute the Premium desirability strategy for India, using artist-led and culturally relevant initiatives to drive consideration and conversion.

-
Own the artist and partner flywheel for Premium growth, evolving artist advocacy, fan experiences, and partnership programs toward measurable Premium outcomes.

-
Shape and execute the Premium opportunity within existing in-person activations, including film partnerships, bespoke music events, festivals, and other relevant cultural moments.

-
Partner with local Music & Podcasts, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to identify and activate artists, creators, and partners that can help grow Premium.

-
Design and run desirability initiatives with clear success metrics, using performance data and audience behaviour to understand what works and continuously improve the strategy.

-
Own the fandom value opportunity for Premium end-to-end, from identifying opportunities to partnering with Product on fan-facing Premium features and experiences.

-
Develop business cases and evaluate the impact of desirability, artist, and partner initiatives to inform where we invest and scale.

-
Capture and share learnings that strengthen the India Premium Growth playbook, contribute to cross-regional Growth initiatives, and support adjacent growth priorities when business needs require it.

-
Integrate AI-driven tools and workflows thoughtfully to improve decision-making and execution efficiency.
Who You Are
-
You have 5+ years of experience across growth, marketing, partnerships, strategy, or related roles in a digital consumer business such as streaming, music, entertainment, media, or technology.

-
You have strong experience with music and fandom and understand how fan communities form, what drives engagement, and how fandom can translate into measurable business outcomes.

-
You understand growth marketing and connect cultural and creative ideas to measurable outcomes such as consideration, conversion, and subscriber growth.

-
You have experience independently owning and scaling artist-led campaigns, partnerships, live experiences, or similarly complex consumer initiatives from strategy through execution and measurement.

-
You are comfortable using data and audience insights to make decisions, test hypotheses, measure impact, and refine your approach.

-
You work effectively across functions and can influence outcomes without direct authority, particularly when collaborating with Music, Marketing, Partnerships, Product, and other teams.

-
You are curious about cultural trends and user behaviour in India and enjoy testing, learning, and iterating to understand what drives Premium consideration and conversion.

-
Experience working directly with artists, labels, fan platforms, music or entertainment marketing, or Product teams on consumer-facing experiences can help you succeed in this role.
Where You’ll Be
-
This role is based in Mumbai

-
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

jobs.description:

We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 


Our Revenue Growth team drives advertiser acquisition and retention at scale by turning data into action. We build and run scalable go-to-market programs that help advertisers succeed, through lifecycle communications and seller-facing actions. 
As a Senior Program Analyst - GTM Ops, you'll own the technical layer that makes Revenue Growth actually run. Working within Spotify's broader data infrastructure, you'll build the team-specific tools, endpoints, and pipelines our programs depend on — the reporting that helps sellers act, the data feeds that power our advertiser tools, the pipelines that keep everything moving. Your work won't be abstract; it shows up directly in what the team ships and what sellers experience.

jobs.title: Audiobook Licensing & Partnerships Manager - Japan
jobs.description:

Our mission is to empower creators and consumers by delivering the best audiobook content with unmatched quality and accessibility. We are building a thriving ecosystem that scales with creativity, collaboration, and innovative technology.

We’re building Spotify’s audiobook business in Japan and looking for someone to lead our relationships with Japanese publishers. jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager Indonesia
jobs.description:
At Spotify, we believe that music, podcasts, and culture move the world. We’re looking for a Content Marketing Manager to shape how Spotify shows up across Indonesia’s social platforms. You’ll help bring Spotify’s music, podcast, and cultural moments to life through storytelling that Indonesian audiences want to follow, engage with, and share.
 
Based in Jakarta and reporting to the Content & Social Marketing Lead - Indonesia, you’ll be a hands-on member of the team, turning cultural insights and marketing priorities into locally relevant content. You’ll work closely with agency partners, creators, artists, labels, and teams across Spotify to develop and deliver content across TikTok, Instagram, X, and emerging channels. You’ll combine strong creative instincts with performance insights to understand what’s working, adapt quickly, and keep Spotify relevant in fast-moving cultural conversations.

What You'll Do 
- Own the day-to-day execution of Spotify Indonesia’s social channels across Meta, TikTok, X, and emerging platforms, helping strengthen Spotify’s position as a go-to platform for music and podcast fans in Indonesia.

- Contribute to Spotify’s social voice and presence in Indonesia, creating culturally relevant, platform-native storytelling that feels authentic to local audiences while remaining consistent with Spotify’s brand.

- Lead content marketing initiatives tied to artist and podcast releases, live events, editorial moments, and on-platform campaigns, including video content from ideation through distribution.

- Spot cultural trends, fandom signals, emerging formats, and conversations early, translating them into relevant content opportunities for Spotify.

- Brief and collaborate with agencies and internal cross-functional teams to develop and produce content across social and other relevant media channels.

- Build and maintain relationships with artists, labels, podcast and video creators, agencies, and internal partners, identifying opportunities for content and co-creation while managing expectations and keeping projects moving.

- Navigate a high-volume stakeholder environment across Marketing, Creative, Editorial, artist and label partnerships, and global teams while maintaining alignment and delivering at pace.

- Use data and performance insights to evaluate content, optimize approaches, and clearly communicate learnings and recommendations to internal partners.

- Share learnings and best practices with regional and global teams, contributing to how Spotify approaches content and social marketing across markets.
Who You Are
- You have 7+ years of experience in content marketing, including social media, with experience spanning strategy and creative work in Indonesia.

- You have a strong understanding of Indonesia’s digital and social landscape, fandom behavior, cultural conversations, and the ways audiences engage across different platforms.

- You have experience working with creators, agencies, and cross-functional teams to deliver impactful social and content campaigns.

- You’re confident planning and developing social media and content marketing strategies that can extend across other relevant media channels.

- You have strong creative instincts and are deeply connected to internet culture, music, podcasts, and fandoms, with an eye for emerging trends, formats, and conversations.

- You’re comfortable using data and insights to inform creative decisions, measure performance, and optimize campaigns.

- You’re skilled at managing multiple stakeholders across internal teams, external partners, agencies, and creator ecosystems.

- You’re organized and comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities in a fast-moving environment.

- You have strong communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia and English. You’re familiar with Spotify as a product and understand how audiences use and engage with the platform.

- Experience across broader marketing and media channels, including creator and influencer marketing, will help you thrive in this role.
Where You'll Be 
- This role is based in Jakarta.

- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
